methodology: Original source photos, automatic crops fixed before fitting, fresh grids and ordinary production count search. Errors compare exported designs with estimated two-colour masks, not published cutting paths. The separate known-count diagnostic is explicitly labelled and supplies no production input.

error.renderer: resvg from exported cut_geometry.json; antialias coverage threshold 0.5

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

web.changeInterpretation: The checker is the sole cut-count change. One printed-paper case, vissevasse-arranged-r3c4, retains 5+5 cuts and all candidates fail image fidelity; its differing wall-clock-limited refinement checkpoint gives a small error change, not attributed to the new successful-candidate exit rule.
